verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Stripe serves an llms.txt at docs.stripe.com/llms.txt. Its opening lines are written as instructions for agents. Billing docs are also served as agent-friendly Markdown (e.g., billing.md returns HTTP 200), and many cited doc pages use .md URLs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs effectively, and evidence of how thoroughly llms.txt covers Billing-specific pages.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
